description: Prepare a version- and jurisdiction-scoped Odoo payroll requirements/debugging brief; no payroll configuration or legal/tax determination.

routing.when_to_use: Use when translating an explicitly scoped payroll or time-off workflow into Odoo configuration requirements or diagnosing supplied Odoo payroll behavior.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: deployed Odoo exact version, edition and installed modules; entity and employee/work location jurisdictions; approved payroll/leave policy and effective dates; currency/pay period; redacted sample contract/payslip/rule; accounting map and acceptance criteria; primary current legal/Odoo docs.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: requirements matrix with policy source, Odoo field/module expectation, rule ordering/data dependencies, test cases, open decisions and Eric handoff.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Confirm deployed version/edition (Payroll availability may differ), installed modules, company/entity and countries. Do not use generic source examples as current module facts. 2. Capture approved business rules for salary components, inputs, deductions, leave types/approval, contracts, pay period and accounting entries; separate policy from configuration. 3. For each requirement map source policy → expected model behavior → fields/module needed → input/outputs → acceptance test. No hardcoded rates, deduction formula, PTO days, or tax rules without approved policy/current primary authority. 4. For payslip issue, compare redacted inputs, contract wage period, salary structure/rule sequence, categories, inputs and resulting line arithmetic; isolate expected-vs-actual deltas. 5. For journal integration, reconcile debit/credit mapping to approved account map, prove balance and period; do not post. 6. Draft synthetic tests for gross, deductions, net, leave approval and journal mapping; include edge conditions like missing inputs, annual/monthly wage basis, retroactive dates and rounding. 7. Verify relevant Odoo docs for exact deployed version and cite current primary tax authority for jurisdiction-dependent rules. If authority unavailable, mark unresolved for payroll specialist/counsel. 8. Deliver requirements, acceptance tests and technical handoff to Eric; no module install, payroll run, payslip edit, or configuration write.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
